Practice your aim sparingly, and conserve your cartridge supply. 

Collect basic medications for you and your loved ones, and medical tools. Syringes, scalpels, hemostats.

Get a collection of textbooks sufficient for a homeschooling ciriculuum, before those textbooks are retroactively edited. English, Math, Social Studies, Science, Health, Physical Education, Craft, and Foreign Language (probably should be Spanish, like it or not it'll be the most useful). Get/print out physical copies, do not trust ones hosted online because they can still be edited. 

Pray more, and practice being stoic. Rule yourself and cultivate the self-discipline you know you lack.

Learn how to survive for at least 3 months without access to electricity, clean running water, or grocery access. Have the tools and supplies needed to last that long if possible; pool resources if needed. Look to the Pentagon's current Operation Fortress preparations and follow their lead. They're preparing to save themselves and are leaving the civilian infrastructure completely unhardened. Take their preparation as a warning.

Tell no one you are preparing for anything. If they know you have stockpiled, and something terrible happens, they will eventually come begging for food because they didn't prepare and they'll eventually turn hostile if you refuse.

In the meantime, be active in your communities and try to work on civil solutions, for as long as the solutions remain available. This is my rule of thumb: *"Until the last ember dies in the last burned remnants of the last surviving courthouse in the entire country, and there is thereafter truly and totally no remaining venue to be heard civilly under the law, you shall not pick up your rifle for any other purpose but hunting and self-defense. Non-negotiable. Last resort means the last resort."*

And I'll say this twice: Pray. More.

Preface: I've been a member here longer than most of yall, going back to the reddit days on the donald. I have voted for Trump 3 times. I am 37 and have been a nationalist and "America first" for several years before Trump became president.

Just my opinion, Trumps second term has seemed phony to me. Democrats won in 2020 with 81 millions votes, then suddenly 7 million of their voters disappear in 2024 and Trump wins. That's not coincidence, that's the system/shadow government/ you-name-it, making an agreement to with Trump to let him win. That explains his failed term so far with less deportations with Obama and visibly more jeets and arabs walking around our country than under Biden, as well as the cost of gas nationally increasing compared to Biden as well as the coat of groceries increasing. Put simply, Trump has nothing. By his 2024 terms resume, he's a neocon. He hasn't delivered on a single promise thay I elected him for. So yes, I am one of those guys that has acknowledged reality and called out Trump. I notice many of you here get menstrual when I call out Trump, demanding I be cancelled (how obese leftist of you), but look, I was right. 

Look, of you call yourself maga and not a nationalist, your priorities are Trump and your ego and not your nation and people. You are a revitalized neocon and honestly you had no chance of winning any election running on that political ideology. When Trump attacked Iran with no plan or end in sight, then went on national TV to declare that Americans do not have talent and therefore need h1b migrants from India, then went on a 6 month twitter rant about pools and his ball room, it was over. 

Tldr: yall didn't get swept because of nationalism and deportations, you got swept because he had the independent vote in 2024 and literally gave it away in 2026 by being a neocon.

Pick up the pieces and rebuild. Reminder this is about America, our people, our culture, our heritage and history, not about Trump snd Maga.

Time to rebuild.
